Every fact block in parts C and C-two of this section cites exactly one physical page of the registered snapshot by anchor, and the statement is paraphrased from that page alone; provisional night rules and license categories resolve to the first selected page, the performance test and renewal rules to the second, duplicates, changes and restrictions to the third, and the registry, notations, mopeds, display and citation rules to the fourth.

Confidence: high for the first, second and fourth pages, which are stated directly in the text layer. The third selected page carries no text layer at all (it is an image-only page in the registered snapshot), so its facts were read from the rendered page and should be confirmed visually by the auditor; the minimum-age numeral on the first page is likewise rendered graphically rather than as text, and that fact is also stated in text on the class three paragraph of the previous section.

Known source hazard: the manual's text layer carries a superseded hidden layer on some pages; every statement here was checked against the visible rendered page, not the hidden text, and no claim rests on hidden lines.
